dcterms:description: The CoNLL-2012 Shared Task data sets are dedicated to the modeling of unrestricted coreference resolution in three languages: Arabic, Chinese, and English. The data sets include various annotation layers, such as part-of-speech (POS) tags, syntactic parses, word senses, named entities (NE), and semantic roles (SRL).
dcterms:title: CoNLL-2012 Shared Task Data Sets
